entries.label: fmt, check-sql, host+wasm32 Clippy, and unit suites on clean HEAD
command:
cargo fmt --all -- --check &&
  python3 scripts/check-sql.py &&
  cargo test --locked -j 4 -p boundaries -p physician-wire -p physician-client -p physician-app &&
  cargo test --locked -j 4 -p physician-app --bin physician-app &&
  cargo clippy --locked -j 4 -p physician-wire -p physician-client -p physician-app --all-targets -- -D warnings &&
  cargo clippy --locked -j 4 --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p physician-wire -p physician-client -p physician-app --no-default-features --features physician-app/web -- -D warnings

entries.label: public-site browser E2E: offline preview, citations/basis, /coda/physician/api live mock + SSE, and 429 budget fallback
physician-sample Chromium suite (26 tests) against ephemeral Postgres and Valkey
command:
set -euo pipefail
  PGDIR=$(mktemp -d)
  VALKEY_WRAP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
  cp ~/.cache/coda-dev/bin/valkey-server "$VALKEY_WRAP_DIR/valkey-server"
  chmod +x "$VALKEY_WRAP_DIR/valkey-server"
  export PATH="$VALKEY_WRAP_DIR:$PATH"
  trap "pg_ctl -D $PGDIR -m immediate stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf $PGDIR $VALKEY_WRAP_DIR" EXIT
  PGPORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')
  initdb -D "$PGDIR" -U postgres --auth=trust >/dev/null
  pg_ctl -D "$PGDIR" -o "-k $PGDIR -p $PGPORT" -l "$PGDIR/pg.log" start >/dev/null
  export CODA_REQUIRE_POSTGRES_TESTS=1
  export PHYSICIAN_RUNTIME_TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:$PGPORT/postgres"
  cargo test --locked -j 4 -p physician-sample --test site -- --ignored --test-threads=1
